draft.summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building high-volume, event-driven platforms in Python and Go. Proven track record owning order pipelines processing 40M+ events/day on AWS Lambda, leading CI/CD and deploy tooling initiatives for platform teams, and mentoring engineers through performance cycles. Deep expertise in Kafka, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and Postgres with on-call leadership experience that reduced incident pages by 80%.

sections.heading: Senior Backend Engineer — Northwind Logistics (2021–2026)
